title: fix(plugin-security)!: a delegated scope held in a context that names no organization covers nothing
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the delegated-administration gate resolves a delegated scope only inside the caller's active organization, so a context that names no organization holds no subtree: it covers no business unit and no user, the delegable-scope report lists no scope and no unit placeable through one, and a write under the scope is refused naming the missing active organization. Nothing is widened: no export, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — a runtime authorization bound inside `@objectstack/plugin-security`; no authorable key, value or metadata type changes, and no `skills/**` or docs page teaches how a delegated scope resolves for a context with no active organization.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:调用方上下文未指明组织时,委派管理(adminScope)不覆盖任何业务单元——覆盖单元集合为空,可委派范围报告无作用域、无可安置单元、无可分配岗位,不覆盖任何用户;以该作用域发起的写入一律 403 拒绝,理由指明缺少活动组织(与组织管理员拒绝同一状态时的措辞、错误类一致)。
- 为什么改:落实规则「上下文未指明组织时持有的委派作用域不覆盖任何东西」(维护者 2026-11-08 裁决「都同意」,选项 A;安全加固,细节归 security#1 席)。
- 风险与回滚:上下文指明组织的所有答案不变,租户级管理员、组织管理员、职务代理的判定不变;仅无活动组织的委派管理者受影响。按先例 c1e08feb2 / 669a8aaa14 声明为收窄(BREAKING,patch 级)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `resolveHeldScopes`(无组织即返回空)与 `authorize` 中新增的无组织拒绝;再看 `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` 里三种部署形态的无组织各腿。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts src/delegated-admin-gate-cross-organization.test.ts`,预期 `Test Files 2 passed`、`Tests 102 passed`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Rule.** A delegated scope held in a context that names no organization covers nothing.

For a context that names no organization (ADR-0123 D1's authenticated session with no active organization), the gate resolves no delegated scope and reads no business unit:

- `scopedBusinessUnitIds` answers an empty set, so the delegated business-unit read admits nothing — the read door answers it as it answers a caller holding no scope (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`), and `canReadObject`, `getReadFilter` and `security/explain` follow the same judgment;
- `describeDelegableScope` lists no scope, no placeable unit and no position assignable through a scope;
- `scopesCoverUser` answers false;
- an assignment or direct grant written under the scope is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the reason "the request carries no active organization to administer" — the wording, and the error class, the organization-administrator branch already gives for the same state (one shared constant now).

A context that names its organization gets every answer it got before. A tenant-level administrator's writes, an organization administrator and a self-delegation of duty are judged as before; a tenant-level administrator's report is unchanged for a context naming its organization.

- `describeDelegableScope`'s tenant-level branch offers a context that names no organization no placeable unit; `organizationBusinessUnitIds` now requires the organization.
- Docs: `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx` states that a tenant-level admin's report enumerates its active organization's units, and that a context naming no organization is offered none.

**Structure.** The one choke point is `resolveHeldScopes`: with no organization it returns no scope before any read. `resolveSubtree` now takes the organization as a required argument. The scope parsing moved into a module function (`adminScopesCarriedBy`) shared by `resolveHeldScopes` and the write gate's refusal. `organization-scope.ts` is untouched.

**Docblocks.** The stale ones were rewritten: `callerOrganizationId`, `scopesCoverUser`, `describeDelegableScope`, `organizationBusinessUnitIds`, the tenant-level branch comment, `resolveHeldScopes` and `resolveSubtree` no longer describe an organization-less resolution. Every ruling-of-record docblock in the source is kept as it was, 6663849489 included. One test docblock citing a ruling of record gained a paragraph and kept its text — the posture describe's, which reads: "[ADR-0090 D12, ruling of record 6663849489] The subtree a delegated scope covers is ONE organization's, whether or not the caller's context names an organization: a unit stamped with another organization is outside it even where its parent link names a unit inside the scope, and so is everything below it."

### Governing text (read on `origin/main`)

- Maintainer ruling, 2026-11-08: 「都同意」 — option A: "fail closed — with no organization on the context, resolveHeldScopes resolves no subtree: scopedBusinessUnitIds returns an empty set, describeDelegableScope returns no scopes and no placeable units, scopesCoverUser returns false, and the write gate refuses with a no-active-organization reason, as organizationAdminFailure already does."
- ADR-0123 D1: "\"Authenticated, with no active organization\" is a declared session state, not an illegal intermediate to be eliminated at the mint point."
- ADR-0123 D2: "Tenant-scoped reads resolve to nothing; tenant-scoped writes are refused loudly." — "*Writes that place or move a row* — `insert` and `update` — are **refused**, with `PERMISSION_DENIED` / HTTP 403 and a message that **names the missing active organization**."
- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` (`grantAppliesInTenant`): "⛔ There is no \"every organization\" mode: no option selects one and nothing falls back to one. A caller that has an organization passes it; a caller that has none gets no stored grant at all."
- ADR-0131 C1: "Default Organization load-bearing under `single` and created before application seed datasets load"; D11: "`single` is never a reason for a row to be org-less."
- Related, not the decider: ADR-0105 D6 red line 2 (every business-unit mechanism operates within one organization); the precedents c1e08feb2 (#31295) and 669a8aaa14 (#31442), which bound the same gate's walk.

## Tests

Pins flipped, each with a one-line reason in the test ("a context that names no organization holds nothing"):

- `delegated-admin-gate-cross-organization.test.ts` — the no-organization control now asserts an empty report and the `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` refusal naming the missing active organization, with the org-naming write as its control.
- `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` (single, group, isolated) — the gate's answers for a context naming no organization are empty (covered units, placeable units, a member inside the scope not covered); the read door refuses it as it refuses a caller holding no scope; a new leg per posture refuses every write of that context, inside the scope too, naming the missing active organization; the org-naming context keeps every answer. The `single` Default-Organization door leg now stores nothing for the no-organization context and stores the in-scope assignment for the org-naming one.
- `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` — the no-organization describe from c1e08feb2 now pins that a context naming no organization holds nothing over a stamped and an organization-less root; the anchor-by-organization leg's no-organization report is empty.
- `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` (single, group, isolated) — a tenant-level administrator's report through the registered security service offers its own organization's units only, and no unit to a context naming no organization; beside the WRITER control, the door, `canReadObject`, `getReadFilter` and explain answer a no-organization context's delegated read as they answer a caller holding no scope.

The no-organization tenant pin also asserts that `assignablePositions` equals the org-naming report's (non-empty) list.

Fixtures that reached the gate with a context naming no organization only incidentally now name the organization their tree belongs to; no assertion changed: `delegated-admin-gate.test.ts` (two harnesses), `delegated-admin-gate-catalog.test.ts`, `granted-by-writer-provenance.test.ts` (the delegate's session carries the Default Organization, and the target is its member), `objects/reserved-identity-names.test.ts`, `security-plugin.test.ts` (the explain harness).

## Acceptance notes

- The read door's answer to a context that names no organization is `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the answer a caller holding no scope gets, not an empty list: with no covered unit the delegated admission is null and the caller's own sets decide. Measured in all three postures.
- `resolveSubtreeById` keeps its `null` organization bound and its ADR-0105 D6 docblock as written; no caller of it in the gate passes `null` any more.
- Three open drafts touch `packages/plugins/plugin-security` (#31443, #31438, #31466). None touches a line this diff changes; a local merge-tree of each onto this branch is clean.

## Verification

Rule plus counts, on head `e5d0a791b8` for round 1. Round 3, head `304ed565eb` (one docs page and one assertion): the two-minute check `Tests 102 passed (102)`; the derived union 97 of 97 exit 0, docs families included. Round 2, head `5068ea53fa` (origin/main merged in): plugin-security suite `Test Files 249 passed (249)`, `Tests 5895 passed | 45 skipped (5940)`, typecheck exit 0; ablation of the two tenant-level guards turned exactly the 3 tenant-level legs red (3 failed, 267 passed of 270), then restored; `dispatch-gates --commands` 66 derived, 66 run; dogfood battery `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Tests 3629 passed | 41 skipped (3670)`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` — `Test Files 249 passed (249)`, `Tests 5889 passed | 45 skipped (5934)`; the verify lock's `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security run typecheck` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` ×2 and `check:test-typecheck`: 0 files / 0 errors held in the debt ledger).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation — the three guards reverted on disk, then restored</summary>

On the gate file as committed before its last, comment-only commit (blob 5d1c9435fa), with the guard in `resolveHeldScopes`, the write gate's refusal and the required organization of `resolveSubtree` reverted on disk (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchors hit 1/1, blob moved each time), the three pinning files ran 14 failed / 250 passed (264): every red test is a no-organization leg, and every org-naming control stayed green. Restored: blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, guard counts back to 1 / 1. A first attempt was refused by the tool on its own evidence before any test ran (the replacement was a substring of the anchor) and restored; it is not counted.

</details>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths; the change set read from the merge base) derived 66 families at e5d0a791b8. Each ran once, its exit code captured before any pipe: 66 × exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (packages outside this closure had no `dist/`); after every package was built it answered `122 published require entry point(s) across 72 package(s) load`, exit 0, and that run is the one counted.
- `check:adr-0087-registration` reads the changeset as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- The families CI runs over the whole tree (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, …) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

</details>
